messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

This swelling is known as peripheral edema.
The swelling may add to weight changes.
The swelling becomes more common with age.
Triplet: ["swelling in legs, feet, or hands", "has alternative name", "peripheral edema"]

The relation 'has alternative name' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject condition or effect is also known by the object name.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'known as': The subject medical condition is also referred to by the name specified by the object entity.
B. 'can cause': The subject entity may lead to or result in the condition or effect specified by the object entity.
C. 'may be accompanied by': The subject condition or entity may occur alongside or be associated with the condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'caused by': The subject condition is caused by the pathogen or factor specified by the object entity.
E. 'can occur when': The condition specified by the subject entity may arise under the circumstances described by the object entity.
